meta.currentTop100Policy: Latest dated TML ATP Top-100 snapshot on or before today for the live current season; stable player IDs.
meta.top100SeasonPolicy: For completed seasons, use the final TML ATP ranking snapshot published within that calendar year. For the live current season, use the latest available dated snapshot on or before today. Preserve co-ranked players; count rows without stable player IDs separately and exclude them from player-level height calculations. Each cohort is analyzed against match statistics from the same calendar year.
meta.seasonDefinition: Calendar year in the TML tournament ID; not a rolling 52-week window.
meta.statistics: Hold% = service games won / service games played. Break% = return games won / return games played. Combined = Hold% + Break%.
meta.sampleNote: ATP tour-level singles match results include retirements in W-L. Walkovers and no-play defaults are excluded. Retirement match statistics are not used for Hold/Break because the match sample is partial. Missing or inconsistent stat lines contribute results but no service/return games.
meta.environmentNote: TML indoor Yes/No values and equivalent I/O, Boolean and 1/0 encodings are normalized. Unknown hard-court settings stay in All hard but not in Indoor hard or Outdoor hard.
meta.usage: Personal, educational and non-commercial research only. Raw source CSVs are not included. Keep this derived asset private; do not redistribute or use commercially.
